objective: Reuse exact root column layouts across quadratic public targets and fuse inherited-root products directly into the cached nested matrix.

selected_policy.layout_cache: automatic for quadratic generator systems; cubic systems retain uncached construction
selected_policy.exact_guard: a hit is accepted only if every product maps and every cached column is observed
selected_policy.fused_pack: on an exact hit, form, cancel, and pack each shifted polynomial row directly into the nested dense matrix

controls.KIC_F4_INHERIT_LAYOUT_CACHE: 0 disables and 1 forces layout reuse; unset selects quadratic systems
controls.KIC_F4_DISABLE_INHERIT_FUSED_PACK: 1 retains materialized sparse rows on layout hits

acceptance: cached and uncached inherited-root matrices are byte-identical
missing or extra cached support falls back to a fresh layout
nested fused and materialized matrices are byte-identical at degrees 2 through 4
all four real Semaev root packing cells improve
every quadratic frozen and holdout rung improves against fully uncached construction
the cubic rung is bypassed by the automatic cache policy
all stage verdict digests, tree counters, matrix counters, and word-operation counts match
claim_boundary: Public-synthetic decomposition-stage engineering evidence only. This changes root construction overhead, not the factor base, Macaulay row space, solver tree, relation yield, asymptotic complexity, Pollard-rho comparison, external-target capability, or any key-recovery result.
